columns.name: school
columns.description: student's school (binary: 'GP' - Gabriel Pereira or 'MS' - Mousinho da Silveira)

columns.name: sex
columns.description: student's sex (binary: 'F' - female or 'M' - male)

columns.name: age
columns.description: student's age (numeric: from 15 to 22)

columns.name: address
columns.description: student's home address type (binary: 'U' - urban or 'R' - rural)

columns.name: famsize
columns.description: family size (binary: 'LE3' - less or equal to 3 or 'GT3' - greater than 3)

columns.name: Pstatus
columns.description: parent's cohabitation status (binary: 'T' - living together or 'A' - apart)

columns.name: Medu
columns.description: mother's education (numeric: 0 - none,  1 - primary education (4th grade), 2 - 5th to 9th grade, 3 - secondary education or 4 - higher education)

columns.name: Fedu
columns.description: father's education (numeric: 0 - none,  1 - primary education (4th grade), 2 – 5th to 9th grade, 3 – secondary education or 4 – higher education)

columns.name: Mjob
columns.description: mother's job (nominal: 'teacher', 'health' care related, civil 'services' (e.g. administrative or police), 'at_home' or 'other')

columns.name: Fjob
columns.description: father's job (nominal: 'teacher', 'health' care related, civil 'services' (e.g. administrative or police), 'at_home' or 'other')

columns.name: reason
columns.description: reason to choose this school (nominal: close to 'home', school 'reputation', 'course' preference or 'other')

columns.name: guardian
columns.description: student's guardian (nominal: 'mother', 'father' or 'other')

columns.name: traveltime
columns.description: home to school travel time (numeric: 1 - <15 min., 2 - 15 to 30 min., 3 - 30 min. to 1 hour, or 4 - >1 hour)

columns.name: studytime
columns.description: weekly study time (numeric: 1 - <2 hours, 2 - 2 to 5 hours, 3 - 5 to 10 hours, or 4 - >10 hours)

columns.name: failures
columns.description: number of past class failures (numeric: n if 1<=n<3, else 4)

columns.name: schoolsup
columns.description: extra educational support (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: famsup
columns.description: family educational support (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: paid
columns.description: extra paid classes within the course subject (Math or Portuguese) (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: activities
columns.description: extra-curricular activities (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: nursery
columns.description: attended nursery school (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: higher
columns.description: wants to take higher education (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: internet
columns.description: Internet access at home (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: romantic
columns.description: with a romantic relationship (binary: yes or no)

columns.name: famrel
columns.description: quality of family relationships (numeric: from 1 - very bad to 5 - excellent)

columns.name: freetime
columns.description: free time after school (numeric: from 1 - very low to 5 - very high)

columns.name: goout
columns.description: going out with friends (numeric: from 1 - very low to 5 - very high)

columns.name: Dalc
columns.description: workday alcohol consumption (numeric: from 1 - very low to 5 - very high)

columns.name: Walc
columns.description: weekend alcohol consumption (numeric: from 1 - very low to 5 - very high)

columns.name: health
columns.description: current health status (numeric: from 1 - very bad to 5 - very good)

columns.name: absences
columns.description: number of school absences (numeric: from 0 to 93)

columns.name: G3
columns.description: final grade (numeric: from 0 to 20, output target)
